You can use the following operations to identify the correct version of OpenSearch or Elasticsearch
for your domain, start an in-place upgrade, perform the pre-upgrade check, and view progress:
• get-compatible-versions (GetCompatibleVersions)
• upgrade-domain (UpgradeDomain)
• get-upgrade-status (GetUpgradeStatus)
• get-upgrade-history (GetUpgradeHistory)
For more information, see the AWS CLI command reference and Amazon OpenSearch Service API
Reference.
